description: Crystal Reports migration and full integration verification: copy 17 missing .rpt and .aspx report files from source Inventory report folder to target, update database connection strings in all .aspx.cs files to point to OBMSUATNEW on DESKTOP-FHKDAA6, then run full end-to-end smoke tests with both API and Angular running to confirm the complete migration works. This FEAT depends on FEAT-001 (DB), FEAT-002 (API), and FEAT-003 (UI) being completed first.
steps: Copy 17 missing report files from d:\Gunma\FWG-Malaysia-New\UatReports-new\UatReports\Inventory\ to d:\Gunma\Gunma---Poilt\Gunma - Report\Inventory\. Files: AssetAllocationReport.aspx, AssetDamageReport.aspx, AssetDisposalReport.aspx, AssetMaintenanceReport.aspx, AssetMasterReport.aspx, AssetReturnReport.aspx, AssetTransferReport.aspx, BSRReport.aspx, GRNReport.aspx, IssueReturnReport.aspx, POReport.aspx, PRReport.aspx, StockAdjustmentReport.aspx, StockIssueReport.aspx, StockLedger.rpt, StockLedgerReport.aspx, StockTransferReport.aspx. Copy the corresponding .aspx.cs code-behind files as well.

Read each copied .aspx.cs file and find the database connection string or connection setup code. Replace any connection string pointing to the source server/database with: Data Source=DESKTOP-FHKDAA6;Initial Catalog=OBMSUATNEW;Integrated Security=True;Persist Security Info=False;Pooling=False;MultipleActiveResultSets=False;Encrypt=False;TrustServerCertificate=True;Connect Timeout=30
Check the two existing target .aspx.cs files (HQStockLedger.aspx.cs and BranchStockLedgerReport.aspx.cs) to confirm they already point to OBMSUATNEW — update if they don't.

Run full API smoke tests: start API with 'dotnet run --project "d:\Gunma\Gunma---Poilt\Gunma - API\OBMS.WebAPI\OBMS.WebAPI.csproj"'. Test the following endpoints (all must return 200): GET /api/Inventory/GetBrandMasters, GET /api/Inventory/GetUOMMasters, GET /api/Inventory/GetWarehouseMasters, GET /api/Inventory/GetOpeningStockList, GET /api/Inventory/GetPRList, GET /api/Inventory/GetPOList, GET /api/Inventory/GetGRNList, GET /api/Inventory/GetPurchaseReturnList, GET /api/Inventory/GetStockIssueList, GET /api/Inventory/GetStockIssueReturnList, GET /api/Inventory/GetStockTransferList, GET /api/Inventory/GetStockAdjustmentList, GET /api/Inventory/GetStockDamageLossList, GET /api/Inventory/GetStockBalanceSummary, GET /api/Inventory/GetAssetList, GET /api/Inventory/GetAssetAllocationList?activeOnly=true, GET /api/Approval/GetPendingApprovals (may return 401 without token — that is correct), GET /api/StockRequest/GetBSRList (may return 401 without token — that is correct), GET /api/Inventory/GetInventoryItems (regression — must return existing data).
Run full Angular smoke tests: start 'ng serve --port 4200' and navigate to 12 key routes listed in acceptance criteria. Confirm each renders without browser console errors.
Set FEAT-004 status to 'completed' and record all smoke test results in findings.
